paragraphs: Chevin Fleet Solutions sells FleetWave, fleet management software meant to be the single source of truth for a fleet. The promise to buyers is to save time, save money and stay compliant.

FleetWave is described as a single, integrated platform that connects every part of operations to give teams full operational control. A code-free integration tool called Smart Integrate comes as standard. SmartForms builds custom forms, automates processes and captures data in real time at no extra cost. FleetWave Driver is a mobile application included within the SaaS subscription. Field teams use it for bespoke forms, data capture and virtual paperwork on the go. The software comes in three editions, Lite, Core and Advanced, for businesses of any size or complexity.

Chevin describes itself as a UK-based business with global reach and hundreds of North American clients. It says it manages over one million vehicles and associated assets across the world. It lists ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 accreditation. Offices are named in the United Kingdom, United States, Australia, France and Belgium.

quote.text: FleetWave is a multi award-winning fleet management software, designed to be the single source of truth for your fleet.
